title: Yamato 2520
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 281097 and TMDB show 44979. Its episodes are on TMDB show 44979. The node moves from TVDB 85230 to series 281097. AniDB episode 1-3 ("明日への希望" (Hope for Tomorrow) to "戦闘" (Battle)) are TVDB S1E1 "Hope for Tomorrow" to TVDB S1E3 "Combat" and TMDB S1E1 "Vol.1 明日への希望" (Hope for Tomorrow) to TMDB S1E3 "Vol.3 戦闘" (Combat); AniDB S1-S3 ("ヤマトわが心の不滅の艦[ふね] -宇宙戦艦ヤマト胎動篇-" (Yamato the Mirror of My Eternal Memory: Space Battleship Yamato Quickening Series) to "Tokio in Yamato 2520") are TVDB S0E1 "Yamato The Mirror Of My Eternal Memory - Space Battleship Yamato Quickening Series" to TVDB S0E3 "TOKIO in YAMATO 2520" and have no TMDB episode (TMDB has none of them). TVDB series 85230 no longer exists. Series 281097 YAMATO2520 carries all six of the node's items: the three episodes by their Japanese titles and the three specials (S2 Vol. 0 is the video titled 銀河100年戦争). The Star Blazers series 77773 carries only the three episodes, so 281097 is the target. Its TMDB show 44979 holds the three episodes.
